content: react-native-iap 16.6.1 (npm latest): Nitro-based (peer react-native-nitro-modules ^0.36.5 vs latest 0.37.1, a pinning footgun), Google Play Billing 8+, StoreKit 2 (iOS 15+), Expo config plugin, README suggests kotlinVersion 2.2.0 via expo-build-properties, devDeps on Expo 57.
